sentences.text: It is stated by the learned counsel for the appellant that although initially charge under Section 376(2)(n) of I.P.C. and 6 POCSO Act along with 363, 366 of I.P.C. has been framed against the present petitioner.
However, the learned trial court has found him guilty for the offences punishable under Section 363, 366 only and he has been sentenced to undergo RI for a period of five years.
He further submitted that the petitioner was on bail all along during trial.

11. Taking into consideration the submission, the appellant is directed to surrender before the learned Adhoc Additional Sessions Judge (FTSC), Jajpur in connection with C.T. Special (POCSO)
Case No.144 of 2019 and move an application for bail.
In such eventuality he shall be released on bail subject to such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the trial court.
